provenance: RPM/CSV occupancy-grid -> micrometre calibration for Xilinx 7-series, replacing the former isotropic 8 um assumption in units.py. Derived 2026-08-22 from Xilinx-official die dimensions (UG475 v1.9 mechanical drawings) cross-fitted with Project X-Ray tilegrid extents, and the empirical CSV grid <-> Vivado SLICE index mapping of this repo's primitive_map.csv.

ug475.title: 7 Series FPGAs Packaging and Pinout Product Specification (UG475 v1.9, 2013-02-14)
ug475.note: Chapter 4 'Die Dimensions with Capacitor Locations' figures. Vendor table lists DEVICE SIZE (F1,G1) and DEVICE KEEPOUT AREA (J1,H1). Keepout-minus-die margins are exactly +6.0 mm (X) and +4.0 mm (Y) on every Kintex-7 figure checked (K325T FBG676/FBG900, K70T FBG484/FBG676); used to resolve die vs keepout pairing on Artix figures.

prjxray.title: Project X-Ray device databases (f4pga/prjxray-db, branch master)
prjxray.note: Community-maintained reverse-engineered tile grid derived from Xilinx Vivado device data; used only for tile-array extents (counts), not for micrometre values.

csv_mapping.empirical: grid_x = 2*SLICE_X + 5 ; grid_y = 2*SLICE_Y exactly over 139,826 placed slice rows (0.5 SLICE-index resolution on both axes)
csv_mapping.vivado_structure: One CLB tile column contains the horizontally adjacent slice pair SLICE_X(2k),SLICE_X(2k+1) at one SLICE_Y (verified in prjxray tilegrid: e.g. tile CLBLL_L_X2Y102 hosts SLICE_X0Y102 and SLICE_X1Y102); SLICE_Y increments one tile row per step.

fit.model: die_mm = N_grid * pitch_mm + 2 * margin_mm (uniform tile lattice + constant pad-ring margin per family)
fit.csv_grid_unit_x_cross_column_note: Adjacent CLB columns are typically 3 tile columns apart in prjxray (CLB-INT-INT-CLB), so cross-column neighbour spacing is ~86 um while the CSV lattice shows 2 units (17.3 um if isotropic) -> cross-column X distances are understated ~5x by the uniform lattice. The single isotropic scale keeps this as a documented approximation.

independent_check_k325t.note: K325T was NOT used in the fit. Predicted capacity with ~70 CLB columns of ~229 total matches the DS160-specified 25,400 CLBs within ~1.5%, supporting the calibration.

fit.uncertainty: Two-point fit; OCR precision of the vendor drawings is ~0.01-0.04 mm, giving roughly +/-0.3 um (column) and +/-0.8 um (row) on the pitches; adopted band for csv_grid_unit_y_um is (21.8, 23.8).

replacement.basis: Y direction: one CSV grid unit = half a tile row = 22.79 um (exact 1:1 SLICE_Y<->tile-row mapping). This is the cleanest physically-anchored scale and is used as the new default scalar.
replacement.legacy_compatibility: units.py keeps RPM_TO_UM_LEGACY = 8.0 for reproducing pre-calibration scans; all new products must carry this JSON's provenance.
